page.layout: One text page; running head at top centre; page number top right; a marginal note in the right margin beside the lines XI and VII; below the text a centred "FINIS," and a catchword-like "IOHAN." line; faint show-through of the other side in the lower half.

main_text.p: XVIII.θ. Notkeri Monachi & Presbyteri, & Waltheri de Svvarzinbach, de quadam decima in Mose apud Sumbri, quam habuit diues.
XVII.θ. Hæinrici de Clingin Abbatis, de Ionsriuti aliisq; redditibus.
XVI. Sedecimis Iani migrauit Liuto kalendis.
XV. θ. Iunta de Valkenstein in nigra Silua, de villicatu in Berge.
XIIII.θ. Wernherus de Arbona Presbyter, de Hitinhuobe.

XIII.θ. Cvvonradi Abbatis de Bufmanch, in cuius anniuer sario datur vinum, pisces, caseus, minor panis, de XX. ouibus monetæ. Est & ob. Heinrici Simprechti, de decima in Granstein & Leituope adiacenti.

XII. Thomæ Apostoli. Dominus Abbas faciat duas caritates per duos dies sequentes: vnam cum piscibus alboccinII, & caf. & vino, & minori leibunculo: aliam sine vino de processione ad capellas. Obiit* Magister coquinæ.
XI.θ. Egilolfus de Rofinberc, de molendino in Hafela & prædio an dim Sunder. *Ruchtmeister.
VII. Eodem die datur stoupus de curia Nephflini in Rorschach, & de decima in Hegu quam habet Gebz de Lindaugia. Est & obitus Rudolfi Dapiferi militis, de Eggon inter Blidegge & Singinbere.
V.θ. Irmingardæ, de decima in Muola, quam habet Hartman. & Bertholdi Ioculatoris, de decima vf dim Bolc in superiori Berge, & de ortis iuxta capellam fororum apud S. Magnum.
III.θ. Svvikkerus de Glatteburg miles, de Zvvozvvile, & Gothefridus, de Chezvvilele.
main_text.head: FINIS,
IOHAN.

page.notes: Marginal note "Ruchtmeister" partly legible at right; lower half of page is show-through and stains. The "θ" marks are read as reference signs and may be misread. Catchword-like "IOHAN." is set as a heading since it stands alone at mid-page.
